name: archetype
description: A recurring stance: a pattern of leanings across several tensions.

aiGuidance.purpose: A named stance defined by its leans-toward relations to poles (public word: sides), one per tension. Agents instantiate archetypes.
aiGuidance.extraction: Short title, a one-sentence summary, a use_when situation; the leanings are relations, not text.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not copy symbolic, elemental or trigram terms from sources.
